desc:
Start with a little wooden stall and grow it into the Big Bakery ✨

🍪 Bake gingerbread men, candy cane cookies and chocolate Yule logs
🎂 Ice every treat by hand and fill your display
🛎️ Serve the queue and take special orders
🧝 Hire elves to bake, ice, stock and serve for you
🔥 Upgrade your ovens all the way to the Ultimate Oven
🚂 Catch the Arctic Express every 10 minutes for free gifts
🎅 Grab the presents Santa drops from his sleigh
📅 Open a new Advent calendar door every day in December

👍 Like and ⭐ Favourite for more Christmas updates!
